verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no documentation of SES sending quotas, requests-per-second limits, burst behavior, or the throttling errors or headers returned when limits are exceeded. The sandbox page only says restrictions apply without listing them, and managed dedicated IP auto-scaling is a related but different feature, so neither earns credit for this story.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can find the documented throughput and rate limits — requests per second, burst behavior, and the headers or errors that signal throttling
